# Fullscape v1.3.0

- Adds a responsive artwork gallery for the playback queue, with direct playback and animated artwork handoffs.
- Adds quick controls for switching between lyrics and the queue and toggling lyric translations.
- Refines artwork transitions, queue layout animations, playback feedback, and Up Next entrances with consistent timing and reduced-motion support.
- Improves progress-bar rendering and playback-state transitions.
- Improves language-aware text rendering, Chinese conversion, lyric-provider parsing, and shared lyric-cache lifecycle handling.
- Restores the F shortcut and full-screen display on current Spotify layouts without requiring legacy player-bar or root elements.
- Restores the bottom-bar Fullscape button, including left-click activation and right-click settings, and reattaches it when Spotify replaces the player bar.

## Install or update

Download `fullscape.js`, copy it to your Spicetify Extensions directory, then run:

```sh
spicetify config extensions fullscape.js
spicetify apply
```

Existing Fullscape installations can also select this release through the built-in update settings. The release includes `fullscape.js.sha256` for checksum verification.
